driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: conservative car parameters (low accel/decel, long tau) calibrated on Tay Son; drives like a compliant Hanoi taxi.
Car violators (custom2) drawn from the car distribution; params identical to car_saval so they behave identically physically but can trigger queue_space_seeking rules.

Saval et al. 2023 motorcycle baseline: higher accel/decel ratio, short tau (aggressive following), wide minGap (1.9m) to match observed overshoot depth; narrow lateral gap (0.3m) matches lane-center riding.
Motone violators (custom1) drawn from the moto distribution; identical physical params to moto_saval but allowed to trigger illegal_left_box and queue_space_seeking rules.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0s is the default lever for box-waiting duration; physical behaviour same as compliant motos but with different distribution.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: motorcycles at the stop line have a 50% chance to run red (p0=0.5); k=0 removes swarm effect as no follower influence observed; p_max caps probability.
Targets M2/early/moto (0.1303 share): p=0.13 gives ~13% early-start probability in the last 5s of red; t_before_green=5s covers the observation window; v_max=2m/s limits creep speed.
Targets M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.21): p_wrong_lane=0.21 matches the 21% of motos using wrong lanes to dodge queues; q=30m triggers on moderate queues; t_g_s=0 keeps green-check off.
Field observation: most motos pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 (80% probability) and t_wait=2s reflects quick lateral filtering.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass U-turners; p=0.1 (10% probability) matches conservative car behaviour.
